items.title: Classify material code diffs and required review assurance before DONE
items.context: Implement the documented review-assurance floor: material code diffs require at least one current-material review round; docs/typo/annotation-only work may remain lower-risk. Use structured state and existing Lattice evidence, not prose-only claims.

items.title: Escalate failure-triggered code-change stories to three local single-host rounds
items.context: If validation fail, bug, verified reviewer finding, post-DONE regression, or repeated rework is present for a material code diff, DONE must require 3 rounds x 1 local host unless a stronger high-risk policy applies.

items.title: Preserve host-neutral Authority boundary in review assurance evidence
items.context: Local review assurance evidence is Non-authority and must not set authorityDone, fullAuthorityDone, productionDone, or imply Authority Server receipt-backed completion.

items.title: Expose actionable DONE preflight diagnostics and tests
items.context: Add tests and CLI diagnostics proving zero-review code DONE blocks, clean code one-round passes, failure signal requires 3x1, high-risk remains 3x2/degraded, and docs-only low-risk is not overblocked.
